name: Soft breaks become one space, two trailing spaces or a backslash make br, entities and escapes decode
markdown:
First line of a paragraph
soft-wrapped onto a second line.

Two trailing spaces  
make a hard break.

A backslash\
also makes one.

Trailing spaces at the end of a paragraph are dropped.  

Entities: & © # A and escaped \*stars\*.

inlines.v: First line of a paragraph soft-wrapped onto a second line.
Trailing spaces at the end of a paragraph are dropped.
